channel.title: GiveOwl – Giveaways & sweepstakes in Czechia
channel.description: Every listing links to the organizer’s official rules. GiveOwl never collects your entries.

item.title: SayBeam Black Friday iPhone 18 Pro Giveaway – SayBeam
item.description: Prize: One iPhone 18 Pro, 256 GB, unlocked, in the winner’s choice of Burgundy, Glacier Blue, Silver or Black (ARV $1,199). Deadline: November 30, 2026. Free entry: email contact@saybeam.com with the subject line "iPhone 18 Pro Giveaway - Free Entry" and your full name, email address and country of residence (see section 4B of the rules). Orders on saybeam.com also earn entries, but no purchase is required and both methods have the same chance per entry. 18+ (or age of majority) wherever the giveaway is permitted; Canadian winners must answer a skill-testing question. Runs Nov 6 – Nov 30, 2026, 11:59:59 p.m. ET; drawing on or about Dec 3, 2026.

Deadline: December 1, 2026. Complete the entry form on the promotion landing page with your name and email address. Free: no purchase, deposit, trade or other financial activity is required. Quebec) and other jurisdictions where Kraken services are available; residents of the UK, Australia and Switzerland are not eligible. Runs Nov 1 – Dec 1, 2026, 23:59 UTC; 10 winners drawn after the close. Canadian winners must answer a skill-testing question.
